name: windows-computer-use
description: Full-control local Windows automation for Codex through UIA3, SendInput, capture, and native OCR.

interface.shortDescription: Native full-control automation for Windows apps
interface.longDescription: Control Windows applications through semantic UI Automation 3 first, then native OCR and physical-pixel mouse/keyboard fallback. The local plugin adds no app allowlist or action confirmation layer of its own and automatically re-observes state after actions.
defaultPrompt: Open an app and complete this Windows task
Inspect this window and operate it semantically
